Before you start

  • Claude Code — the desktop app or CLI. Download at claude.com/claude-code and sign in with a Claude account (Pro/Max or API billing).
  • Access to the plugin repository — github.com/cliwant/contrl-harness. If the repository is private, ask Cliwant to invite your GitHub account first.
  • Cliwant Global MCP connector — powers the GeBIZ bid search. Contact Cliwant (junho@cliwant.com) for your connector URL and access key.
  • Your company's proposal PPTX template (optional) — CONTRL can extract a reusable design system from it, so generated decks match your brand. A default template is also available.

Installation — 3 steps

1

Install the CONTRL plugin

Open Claude Code in any folder and run these two commands:

> /plugin marketplace add cliwant/contrl-harness
✓ Marketplace "contrl-harness" added
> /plugin install contrl@contrl-harness
✓ Plugin "contrl" installed — 9 skills registered
Updating later: run /plugin marketplace update contrl-harness to pull the newest version.
2

Connect the Cliwant Global MCP

This connector gives Claude live access to the Singapore GeBIZ notice index (titles, agencies, closing dates, documents). Add it with the URL Cliwant provides:

$ claude mcp add global-cliwant --transport http <connector-URL-from-Cliwant>
✓ MCP server "global-cliwant" connected
Using the Claude desktop app or claude.ai? You can also add it under Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector with the same URL.
3

Create a workspace folder and start

Make an empty folder for your bid work (one folder can hold many tender projects), open Claude Code there, and search for opportunities:

$ mkdir gebiz-bids && cd gebiz-bids && claude
> /contrl:gebiz find AI chatbot tenders closing this month
Searching Singapore GeBIZ via Cliwant… 6 notices found
That's it. CONTRL shows the matching notices, you pick one, and the pipeline takes over — creating projects/<tender-name>/ with all analysis artifacts inside your folder.

How a bid flows through the pipeline

CONTRL never runs ahead of you: after each stage it stops, shows the result in the tab panel, and asks before starting the next one. Stages marked your call are decision points that wait for your input.

STAGE 1

Bid Search

Search GeBIZ by keyword. Review the full notice list; the one you pick is highlighted and carried forward.

STAGE 2

RFP Analysis

Upload or point to the tender documents (PDF/DOCX). CONTRL extracts requirements, evaluation criteria, and the required proposal structure.

STAGE 3

Strategy Interview your call

A short Q&A about your company, proof points, and competitors — builds the customer/company/competitor picture behind the bid.

STAGE 4

Win Theme & Go/No-Go your call

Three ranked win themes to choose from, plus a scored Go/No-Go dashboard so you can decide whether the bid is worth pursuing.

STAGE 5

Theme Statements & Slide Contents

Your win theme is translated into section-by-section messages, then into full slide-by-slide proposal content.

STAGE 6

Design Template your call

Pick the design your deck will use — the current template, or your own PPTX (see below).

STAGE 7

Slide Plan & Render

Each slide is matched to a layout and rendered. You review in batches and give feedback in plain language.

STAGE 8

Final Delivery

A finished deck.pptx and matching Word proposal, previewable side by side, plus a standalone HTML package you can send to stakeholders.

Choosing your design template

Right before slide design starts, CONTRL asks how the deck should look. Two options:

Option 1 · Default

Use the current design template

Pick from the design template(s) already set up in your workspace. Zero setup — the pipeline proceeds immediately. Best for your first run.

Option 2 · Bring your own

Upload your company's PPTX

Drop in your proposal template file (or give its file path). CONTRL mines it into a reusable design system — layouts, components, brand styles — and every deck after that matches your brand. Extraction takes a few minutes, once.

Example output

FAQ

Where do my files live?
Everything stays in your workspace folder: projects/<tender>/artifacts/ holds the analysis JSON, projects/<tender>/artifacts/render/ holds deck.pptx, deck.docx, and per-slide PNGs. Nothing is uploaded anywhere unless you share it.
Can it run fully automatically?
Yes — say "run everything through render without pausing" and it will. By default it pauses at each stage for your approval.
What language are the outputs in?
English — proposal decks, analysis panels, and documents are written in business English suitable for Singapore public-sector submissions, even if your interview answers are in another language.
The bid search returns nothing / errors.
Check that the Cliwant Global MCP connector is connected (/mcp shows its status). If it's missing or expired, re-add it with your connector URL.
Can I redo just one stage?
Yes. Ask for the stage by name ("regenerate the win themes", "re-render slide 7"). Downstream stages that depend on it are rebuilt automatically.
